findings.fix: Add a per-agent 'subagent signal' column; for Copilot CLI mark [U] and add a live check, or apply the same deny/rewrite to every call (no subagent branch).

findings.claim: v1 cleanup for Copilot CLI is 'Delete the file' ~/.copilot/hooks/context-mode.json and misses the v1 MCP entry. v1 upgrade merges into that file and keeps other hook keys, and open PR #1235 asks to keep user custom hooks; the MCP entry in ~/.copilot/mcp-config.json calls the global 'context-mode' bin.
findings.evidence: src/adapters/copilot-cli/index.ts:222-240 reads existing settings.hooks and rewrites only our types; prall.json #1235 OPEN 'fix(copilot-cli): preserve custom hooks during upgrade'; index.ts:388 fix 'copilot mcp add context-mode -- context-mode'; configs/copilot-cli/.mcp.json command 'context-mode'.
findings.fix: Use the Claude Code rule for this file (remove only entries whose command has 'context-mode hook copilot-cli'; delete the file only when empty) and add mcp-config.json mcpServers['context-mode'] to the footprint (report, do not remove, if user-added).
findings.archaeology: INTRODUCED_BY 9f34c6f1 2026-06-21 PR #787 (configureAllHooks merge). ORIGINAL_INTENT: index.ts:236 'Only treat a hook as drift when it differs from desired'. REGRESSION_RISK: deleting the whole file re-breaks what #1235 asks to keep.
